terms.asn: Autonomous System Number — a unique identifier for a group of IP networks under one operator.
terms.cveSeverity: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures severity rating (Critical, High, Medium, Low).
terms.cidr: Classless Inter-Domain Routing notation. Example: 10.0.0.0/24 covers 256 IP addresses.
terms.slowProfile: Stealth presets that pace the TCP connect scanner: stealth → balanced → aggressive.
terms.masscan: Asynchronous Internet-scale scanner. Fast but noisy.
terms.zmap: Single-packet stateless scanner. Best for sweeping a small port set over a large range.

policy.title: Risk scoring policy
policy.subtitle: Calibration knobs for the probability×impact host score. Changes apply on next host recompute.
policy.confirmResetBody: This replaces every knob with the built-in defaults. Unsaved edits are discarded; nothing is persisted until you save.
policy.confirmRevertBody: This restores the last saved policy and discards your current edits.
policy.descUntaggedImpact: Default impact for hosts without asset tags.
policy.descHighRiskThreshold: Score above which a host counts as high-risk.
policy.groupDescCoefficients: Tune how each host attribute contributes to the overall impact score. The five weights should sum to 1.0.
policy.groupDescHalflives: Controls how fast signal freshness decays. Shorter values make scores respond faster to new findings.
policy.groupDescFloors: Minimum multipliers that remain active regardless of signal age, preventing scores from dropping to zero.
policy.groupDescUntagged: Fallback values applied to hosts that carry no asset tags and therefore have no explicit classification.

onvif.title: ONVIF SOAP
onvif.lead: Read-only presets via the API for device, media, imaging, and PTZ services. Pick HTTP Basic, Digest, or SOAP WS-Security if the camera needs auth. Set Response to JSON for structured fields (RTSP path from GetStreamUri, media_xaddr from capabilities).
onvif.authorizationCallout: Opens an active HTTP session to the camera. Use only on authorized targets.
onvif.responseHint: JSON adds parsed and optional parse_warnings for supported commands.
onvif.labLead: Server-side only. The API tries deduplicated pairs over HTTP Basic with GetDeviceInformation (a default-auth ONVIF operation, so the device only answers when credentials are valid).
onvif.labBulletFile: Pairs from the embedded list or ONVIF_LAB_CREDENTIALS_FILE, capped by ONVIF_LAB_CREDENTIAL_MAX_PAIRS.
onvif.labBulletUsername: If the username field above is set, it overrides the login from each candidate.
onvif.labConfirm: I confirm this host belongs to my organization and I am authorized to test credentials.
onvif.jpegHint: Runs GetStreamUri with the profile token, checks the RTSP host matches this host IP, then grabs one JPEG (same FFmpeg limits as RTSP preview).
onvif.jpegAlt: JPEG frame from ONVIF stream URI
onvif.staleResponse: Response is from <cmd>{{command}}</cmd>. Resend or switch command.
onvif.labMatched: Matched after {{attempts}} attempt(s). Username and password are filled in below.

errors.onvif_command_busy: Too many concurrent ONVIF requests. Try again shortly.
errors.onvif_rate_limited: ONVIF endpoint rate limit reached. Try again shortly.
errors.onvif_lab_probe_disabled: Lab credential probe is disabled. Set ONVIF_LAB_CREDENTIAL_PROBE_ENABLED=true (trusted lab only) and restart.
errors.onvif_service_not_found_for_host: This port is not stored as HTTP, HTTPS, or ONVIF (TCP) for this host.
errors.onvif_http_error: HTTP request to the device failed. Check scheme, path, routing, and firewall rules.
errors.onvif_rtsp_stream_uri_missing: GetStreamUri returned no rtsp:// URI. Check profile token and media path.
errors.onvif_rtsp_stream_uri_invalid: GetStreamUri returned an unusable rtsp:// URI. Check profile token and media path.
errors.onvif_rtsp_stream_uri_host_mismatch: Stream URI points at a different host; refused by SSRF guard.
errors.onvif_auth_failed: Camera rejected SOAP credentials (HTTP 401). Check auth mode, user, and password.
errors.invalid_argument: API rejected the request. Check paths and token format.
errors.rtsp_snapshot_timeout: Timed out waiting for a JPEG frame from the RTSP URI.
errors.rtsp_snapshot_failed: FFmpeg could not capture a frame from the ONVIF stream URI.

rtsp.title: RTSP preview
rtsp.lead: Grab one JPEG frame through the API (TCP or UDP RTSP). "Try common paths" walks typical vendor URLs (Hikvision, Dahua, Axis…) when the path is unknown.
rtsp.authorizationCallout: Opens an active RTSP session. Use only on authorized targets.
rtsp.tryCommonPathsTitle: Tries your stream path first, then a bounded list of common vendor paths
rtsp.previewPlaceholder: Preview appears here after a successful capture.

errors.rtsp_snapshot_timeout: Timed out waiting for a frame. Check the stream path and network route.
errors.rtsp_snapshot_failed: Could not capture a JPEG frame. Check stream path, credentials, and that the device allows RTSP over the selected transport.
errors.rtsp_snapshot_paths_exhausted: No JPEG from any candidate path. Use Capture frame with the exact path from device docs, or try the other transport.
errors.rtsp_service_not_found_for_host: This port has no RTSP service with the selected transport (TCP/UDP) for this host.
